death.note: He was brought to al-Qāhira by boat from al-Ashmūnayn after supervising bridge construction, and was buried there.

relation.note: Cross-reference (ينظر): the entry on Asanbughā al-ʿAlāʾī (D02015) refers the reader to this Asanbughā al-Nājī. Both died in 803 H and share the name Asanbughā, but they are distinct persons.

event.note: Brought by boat after his work in al-Ashmūnayn.

event.desc: Went to supervise the construction of the Sultanic bridges (ʿimārat al-jusūr al-sulṭāniyya).
event.note: Sent to supervise the construction, likely falling ill there before being moved to Cairo.

person.note: アサンブガー・アン＝ナージー、ハージブ（侍従）。彼は803年ジュマーダー・アル＝ウーラー月の最初の10日間に、アル＝アシュムーナインで亡くなった。彼はスルターン橋梁の建設を監督するために派遣されており、カイロへ船で運ばれ、そこで埋葬された。アル＝アイニーがこれを伝えている。

Asanbughā al-Nājī al-Ḥājib. He died in the first ten days of Jumādā al-Ūlā in the year 803 H in al-Ashmūnayn. He had gone to supervise the construction of the Sultanic bridges, so he was brought by boat to al-Qāhira and was buried there. al-ʿAynī related this.
